title: The Crown of Shadows
description: A golden ornate crown with floral details rests on a white tasseled pillow atop a dark blue draped table surrounded by lit candles and handwritten notes. In the background, a large dark horned silhouette with glowing pink eyes stands beneath a vibrant cosmic explosion of colorful paint splatters and a golden fleur-de-lis symbol.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal scene featuring an ornate golden crown with red and teal jewels resting on a white pillow with purple embroidery and red tassels. The pillow sits on a table covered in dark blue velvet surrounded by glowing candles, hanging lanterns, and scattered handwritten notes. Behind it looms a giant black horned demonic silhouette with glowing pink eyes, a large golden fleur-de-lis symbol floating in front of its chest, all set against a chaotic cosmic background of colorful paint splatters and starry nebula.
